author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,
I just want to release the third Travincal Map ;D 

Travincal III 


Title: Travincal III
Created By: resepignev
Game: Nexus
Teams: Blue, Green, Red and Yellow
Details: The two layer map Travincal III is like the old Travincal Map, but there is one major change! Now it's a round map! As I said it's a two layer map with a big hole in the middle. The colors are the same too. The spawns are in the top layer near the stairs to the bottom layer.

replies.author: EinfachNalor
replies.body:
But please make a different spawn protection, like that you have a 5 second protection or something like that, because there are just 2 things that annoy me about travincal 1:

1. People often just shoot into your spawn, while you respawn/always shoot only out of their spawn to use the spawn safety against people who fight in close combat

2. People just running back into spawn after a fight to regen. I asked a few times about it and in that case you are permitted to pursue them and kill them in their spawn, it would be not counted as spawn killing( only if u then kill them after they respawned too) but now the question I ask you is what to do, if you then cant kill them?

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Thank you for ya feedback!

1. That a valid point. I also saw this in some games. In 1.8 I could add the barrierblocks as shield and when you want to leave the spawn you have to run into a teleport region and you'll be teleported outsite of the spawn. This would only work one way. But there is one problem with this: if you are on the second layer(down) how to come on the top one again? More teleport regions maybe... I'll try it out.

2. I think you can define a region that works one way. This means if you leave the region, you can't enter it again. I'll add this to all Travincal maps. (Could a Map Dev confirm this?)

PS: If there are any errors/bugs with the maps or suggestions. Report/Suggest them [Here] :D
